title: Billing Reports
description: Billing Reports documentation for System Admin.
overview: This guide covers billing reports workflows for System Admin.

subtasks.title: Open a practice billing report
subtasks.purpose: Review the current billing cycle and patient billing statuses for every practice.

steps.title: Open Billing Tab
steps.description: Click Billing in the left sidebar.

steps.title: Search Billing by Practice
steps.description: Use the Search box to filter by practice name, ID or email.

steps.title: Sort Billing List
steps.description: Sort by Status or any column header.

steps.title: Read Program Enrollment
steps.description: Read the Program Enrolled chip (e.g. RPM (46)) to see how many patients are enrolled in each program for that practice.

steps.title: Open Billing Report
steps.description: Click the eye icon in the View Report column to open the detailed billing report for that practice.

steps.title: Change Billing Period
steps.description: Click the calendar icon to change the billing period date range before generating the report.

steps.title: Page Through Billing List
steps.description: Change Show entries or use the pager to navigate.

steps.title: Audit Billing Activity
steps.description: Click Event Logs (top of table) to audit billing activity. Notes Billing Period Date shows the current cycle window (start ~ end) for that practice’s care program. The Patients Status chips (T / A / P / L) summarise Total / Active / Pending / Locked counts for quick triage.

subtasks.title: Interpret patient status chips
subtasks.purpose: Understand what the T / A / P / L badges mean before drilling into a report.

steps.title: Read Patient Status Chips
steps.description: On any row, read the four coloured chips under Patients Status.

steps.title: View Underlying Patient List
steps.description: Hover / open the report to see the underlying patient list. Notes T = Total patients in the billing period; A = Active (meeting service-time thresholds); P = Pending (partial data / awaiting review); L = Locked (billing already finalised). Zero-count chips are still shown for context (e.g. L 0 means no billing has been finalised yet for the cycle). Task 6.6 — Patient Management
